page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre above the text. Main text in a single block of italic and roman lines. Show-through of a verse poem from the reverse side appears faintly in the centre and is not transcribed. Signature mark "A 3" and catchword "LE-" at the foot right. Signature of the author "Bartholomeus Candidus Antiacus, S. B." below the text at left.

main_text.p: NVELE à METEREN aut aliis conscriptam e-uoluerent historiam ; eam in istam redegit Epito-men, à qua quid tibi expectandum, malo te ex i-psius, qui sequitur, versu, quàm meis verbis co-gnoscere. Vale, & siqua animaduertes inter le-gendum errata Typographica, ea benigne ignosce & corrige.

page.notes: The faint verse on the centre of the page is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The first line of the lower text block is not legible enough to transcribe. The signature beneath the text is printed in a small italic-like face and reads "Bartholomaeus Candidus Antiacus, S. B." in the scan; the reading given is approximate. The opening word of the first paragraph is printed as "NVELE" followed by "à METEREN" in small capitals.
